This research article investigates the effects of chronic, intermittent low doses of the psychedelic N,N-Dimethyltryptamine (DMT) on mood and anxiety in rodents. The study found that such microdosing produced antidepressant-like effects and enhanced fear extinction learning without significant anxiogenic effects or impairing cognitive function.
